categories.main_business_segments: Shenzhen Siglent Technologies Co., Ltd. focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of general electronic test and measurement instruments. Its main product lines include digital oscilloscopes, waveform and signal generators, spectrum analyzers, vector network analyzers, programmable power supplies, digital multimeters, and electronic loads. The company operates primarily in the electronic measurement instrument manufacturing industry.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies such as high bandwidth low noise oscilloscope technology, high waveform refresh rate technology, high sampling rate DDS signal generator technology, real-time spectrum analysis, and integrated vector network analysis. It employs modular circuit design, digital signal processing algorithms, and software platform modularization to enhance product performance and development efficiency. Manufacturing focuses on software programming, functional testing, and assembly quality control, with core components outsourced to specialized manufacturers.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Siglent serves a broad range of customers including electronic engineers, research and development institutions, production testing facilities, field maintenance teams, and educational institutions. Its products are widely used in industries such as telecommunications, semiconductors, automotive electronics, medical electronics, consumer electronics, and education and research sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Shenzhen, China, with sales and services covering over 80 countries and regions worldwide. It has established subsidiaries in the United States, Germany, Japan, and Malaysia, with the Malaysian production base scheduled to commence operations in April 2025. Major markets include North America, Europe, Asia, and emerging markets in Southeast Asia and India.
categories.supply_chain_position: Siglent operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of electronic test instruments. It outsources core component assembly (such as PCB assembly) to external manufacturers while maintaining control over software development, functional testing, and final assembly quality assurance.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation and R&D with a strategy of 'producing one generation, researching one generation, and reserving one generation.' It emphasizes high-end product development, including expanding bandwidth and resolution in digital oscilloscopes and increasing frequency ranges in RF and microwave instruments. R&D focuses on core technologies such as analog front-end circuits, digital signal processing algorithms, and software platforms. The company also invests in talent development and collaborates with international leaders to enhance its technological capabilities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electronic test and measurement instruments. The company employs a mixed sales model including distribution, direct sales, and ODM, with distribution being the dominant channel. It also earns income from after-sales services and government subsidies related to R&D.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Siglent is positioned as one of the leading domestic companies in China with capabilities to develop and produce the four major general electronic test instruments at high-end levels. It competes with international industry leaders such as Keysight Technologies, Tektronix, Teledyne LeCroy, and Rohde & Schwarz. While foreign companies dominate the high-end market globally, Siglent is rapidly closing the technology gap through continuous innovation and expanding its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 497.4 million, representing a 2.93% year-over-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 112.1 million, a decrease of 27.79% mainly due to increased R&D and sales expenses, exchange losses, and reduced government subsidies. The company maintains strong cash flow with net cash from operating activities of RMB 118 million and total assets of RMB 1.68 billion. R&D investment accounted for 21.81% of revenue, reflecting a growth focus.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Siglent emphasizes high performance, reliability, and cost-effectiveness in its products. It offers high-resolution digital oscilloscopes with bandwidths up to 8 GHz and 12-bit ADC resolution, spectrum analyzers and vector network analyzers with measurement frequencies up to 50 GHz, and RF signal generators up to 67 GHz. The company’s products combine advanced hardware with sophisticated software algorithms, modular design, and user-friendly interfaces, providing comprehensive solutions with strong price-performance advantages. Its brand 'SIGLENT' is recognized globally for quality and innovation.
